writing.exampleCaption: The runtime attribute is what actually polls the future to completion.
writing.explanation: The language defines Future and .await; polling, timers, and I/O readiness come from a runtime you choose, such as tokio or async-std. That keeps async usable on an embedded target with no allocator, at the cost of one decision you have to make per project.
writing.feedback: Something has to drive the future, and that something is the runtime.
